description: This file contains a Python module implementing a file uploader class that handles uploading files via HTTP, including multipart form data encoding, and uses network transactions with timeout handling.

classes.name: FileUploader
classes.description: A class for uploading files over HTTP, supporting single text file uploads and multipart form data uploads, with timeout handling.

methods.name: get_mime_type
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file based on its filename.

methods.name: _encode_multipart_form_data
methods.description: Encodes form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP upload.

methods.name: upload_single_text_file
methods.description: Uploads a single text file using the specified filesystem and content type.

methods.name: upload_as_multipart_form_data
methods.description: Uploads multiple files and form attributes as multipart/form-data.

methods.name: _upload_data
methods.description: Performs the actual data upload via HTTP request with timeout handling.
